llm_response.reason: The website displays several strong scam indicators: (1) complete absence of company or contact information and legal policy pages, (2) use of broad, branded product lists which are typical for fake branded goods shops, (3) trust-building claims like '100% Secure Shopping' and 'Free Shipping Over $60' without substantiation, (4) superficial urgency tactics like 'Hot Product Sale!', (5) all hyperlinks point only to homepage or cart—none link to required pages like Privacy Policy or About Us. These features closely match the listed characteristics for scam sites, especially those running fake online stores.
